# Crusoe

Use `crusoe/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "crusoe-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "crusoe/google/gemma-4-31b-it",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `CRUSOE_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.inference.crusoecloud.com/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `CRUSOE_BASE_URL`.

- https://docs.crusoecloud.com/managed-inference/overview
